title.narrative: Timor-Leste: Strengthening the quality infrastructure system to enhance export compliance of the food and beverage sector

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed technical cooperation is to contribute to the modernization of the NQI system to foster integration into regional and multilateral trading systems. The specific objective is to facilitate the strengthening of standardization and metrological arms of the NQI towards enhancing food safety and quality-related conformity assessment service provision to the agri-business industry, particularly for food <(>&<)> beverages.
